name: clipcommerce-analyst
description: Optional, non-disruptive team improvement skills with evidence-led video-commerce analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Improve team work without replacing existing agents or workflows.
interface.longDescription: Adds optional, evidence-led improvement and video-commerce analysis skills to existing agents. It starts read-only, preserves current projects and workflows, and treats all changes as human-approved suggestions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $adaptive-work-improvement to understand my current work and suggest one safe improvement without changing my existing agent or project.
